*   **Profitability:** Operating Income After Depreciation improved from 358 to 141. Net Income (loss) went from negative -651 to positive 370. 
*   **Expense Management:** While Cost of Goods Sold and Selling, General & Administrative Expenses increased, the improvement in Operating Income suggests efficient overall management.

| Ratio                       | 2016   | 2017   | Trend   |
|----------------------------|--------|--------|---------|
